The '''Malrev system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Thrasybule sector/Legends|Thrasybule sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malrev IV]].

The Malrev system was located above the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] plane,<ref name="Star Wars Handbook 1: X-Wing Rogue Squadron">[[Star Wars Handbook 1: X-Wing Rogue Squadron|''Star Wars Handbook'' 1: ''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'']]</ref> which made it a part of the thick disk.<ref name="EAOC" />
